entities.name: Cecilia Johansdotter of Sweden
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cecilia Johansdotter is the possible name of the wife of King Knut Eriksson of Sweden and mother of King Erik Knutsson. Little is known about her except that she was of aristocratic origins and died sometime after 1193.
